quotient_relation("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.rate", at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "21_hours"), at("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.duration", "21_hours"), source("In 21 hours, a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel"))

rate_relation(at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "90_hours"), "heating_plant.fuel.consumption.rate", at("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.duration", "90_hours"), source("In 21 hours, a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel. How much does it consume in 90 hours?"))
